workers-ai-via-gateway.name: Cloudflare Workers AI (via Cloudflare AI Gateway)

build.prompt:
For code symbol lookups (classes, functions, types, methods): prefer the lsp tool when available. For lsp.workspaceSymbol, the filePath argument must be an EXISTING FILE (not a directory) with the language extension matching your search — e.g. any '.cs' file when searching for C# symbols, '.ts' for TypeScript, '.py' for Python. The file's only purpose is to select which LSP server runs the query; the query itself searches the entire workspace. If you don't know a concrete file path, run glob first to find one, then call lsp.workspaceSymbol. Use lsp.goToDefinition / lsp.findReferences / lsp.hover for navigation once you have a starting file:line:character. Fall back to grep only when the lsp tool isn't in your toolset, or for non-symbol text searches (strings, comments, configs).

Superpowers skills are available — invoke them when the work matches: superpowers:brainstorming before designing new features or making non-trivial decisions; superpowers:writing-plans before multi-step changes; superpowers:test-driven-development before implementation; superpowers:systematic-debugging for non-trivial bugs (NOT for symbol lookups — that's lsp); superpowers:verification-before-completion before claiming work is done; superpowers:requesting-code-review and superpowers:receiving-code-review around review points; superpowers:finishing-a-development-branch when wrapping up. Skills self-describe when to use them — check their descriptions for the exact trigger.
